info.name: SimGuard API
info.description: All SimGuard backend endpoints plus the carrier mock service. Import the environment too, fill email, password and totp, then run Auth 1 and 2.

item.name: Auth
MFA enroll start (first sign-in; set token to the mfaToken)

item.description: Run 1 then 2. Set email, password and totp in the environment. The token is saved automatically.

item.name: Imports
Template (types: departments, employees, sims, allocations, usage)

item.description: Choose a CSV file in the Body tab before sending. The query parameters are switched off by default; tick the ones you want.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Amina Otieno",
  "email": "amina@example.com",
  "organisation": "Acme Ltd",
  "role": "SecurityOfficer",
  "note": "Need access for SIM monitoring."
}

item.name: Carrier mock service
item.description: Needs the mock running (see docs/carrier-feed.md). Set mockKey to the key of the carrier you want to read.
